reader.requirement: INSPECT TALLYING adds each count to identifier-2's existing value and never clears it first, for any elementary numeric counter (signed, scaled, COMP), with a counter repeated under several FOR items accumulating each count, in formats 1 and 3.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior|DialectLevel|CobolVersion over the tally store in InspectEmitter.cs#EmitBody and CobolInspect.cs#Tally: none; the store is StoreArith(counter, counter + count) at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf16_01 C1/C2 use an unsigned PIC 99 counter; not exercised there: negative, scaled and COMP counters, a zero count, one counter under two FOR items, format 3, overflow

probes.expected: -5+2=-3; 1.5+2=3.5; COMP 7+2=9; a zero count leaves it; 3+2+1=6; format 3 3+4=7; PIC 9 holding 9 plus 2 keeps the low digit (INSPECT has no SIZE ERROR phrase)
counter N2 is also identifier-3's subscript: subscript evaluated once (GR5), 1+3=4

probes.printed: COBOL0847 INSPECT TALLYING counter 'NX' shall be an elementary numeric data item
probes.expected: SR6 refusal of a nonnumeric counter

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR11  the text is in GR11 (quoted: "is not initialized by the execution of the INSPECT statement")

reader.notes: Each operand's count is added by one StoreArith per operand in source order. The C7 overflow result (9+2 gives 1) lies outside GR11; the 1985 text gives INSPECT no size-error rule.

refuter.evidence: q3.cob (q3-001, --std 85): PIC 9(18) 999999999999999997 plus 2 gave C1=999999999999999999 (no precision loss). S9(4) COMP -10 plus 6 gave C2=-0004. S9(3) SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE -1 plus 2 gave C3=[001+]. A zero count under two FOR items gave C4=00. `TALLYING K FOR ALL "A" TC (K) FOR CHARACTERS` with K=1 gave K=3 TC1=09 TC2=07: TC (K) is identified once, before K is stored (GR5), and both counters are added to, not set. src/rg.cob: a numeric-edited counter is refused with COBOL0847. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR11 ("is not initialized by the execution of the INSPECT statement"); OK §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR5.
